name: Viper
summary: Stephanie Patricia Green (September 12, 1959 – December 24, 2010), better known by her stage name Viper, was an American pornographic actress, known for a prominent full-body snake tattoo, for co-founding Fans of X-Rated Entertainment with William Margold, and for her disappearance in 1991.
